name: Anonymoustech Instant Download
author: Anonymous Tech

sections.description:
Anonymoustech Instant Download adds a Download button to every plugin inside the WordPress Plugins screen.

With one click, administrators can export any installed plugin as a ZIP file. This is useful for:

  • Backups
  • Development workflows
  • Plugin migration
  • Quick plugin sharing

Features:

  • Instant plugin ZIP download
  • Secure nonce verification
  • Admin-only access
  • No configuration required
  • Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Plugins → Installed Plugins
  4. Click Download next to any plugin
sections.faq:
Who can download plugins?

Only administrators.

Does this modify plugin files?

No. The plugin only generates a temporary ZIP file and immediately removes it after download.
